> Closing an employment cleanly: access revocation, asset recovery, final pay and entitlements, handover of owned work, and record retention. Offboarding is the administrative process with the widest blast radius when it is done badly — a live account and an unreturned laptop belonging to someone who left is a security incident waiting for a date.
